text: The adjoint functor theorem in simplicial type theory (Riehl-Shulman) states: a functor F:A→B between Rezk types has a right adjoint iff:
choices: F preserves all colimits and A is locally small
F has a representable left comma type (i.e., the slice B/Fa is representable for each a)
explanation: In STT, F⊣G iff for each b:B, the type Σ(a:A). hom_B(Fa, b) is representable (its universal element gives the right adjoint G(b)). This is a synthetic version of the universal mapping property.
